From what I understand, I should be able to implement my demo using interledgerjs/packages/pay at master · interledgerjs/interledgerjs · GitHub in combination with a LedgerPlugin implementation. However, I’m having trouble configuring the plugin, because I can’t find a technical specification of rafiki.money for interfacing (compared to Ripplex, which had a clear overview of which URIs and auth credentials to use).

I would very much appreciate it if somebody could help pointing me in the right direction!
